snippet.title: ♥️♣️♦️♠️ Jacks or Better VIDEO POKER in 10 lines of ATARI BASIC
snippet.description:
A regulation game of Jacks or Better VIDEO POKER complete with 5 levels of betting, lights, sounds, all the excitement of Las Vegas in your own home!  You can even keep depositing money to continue playing just like the real thing.  The house always wins. 

The game is written in 10 lines of Atari BASIC for the 2024 BASIC 10 Liner contest: https://gkanold.wixsite.com/homeputerium/copy-of-rules

It's not an arcade shooter but I'm pretty proud of the work and hope is scores well in the contest.  As a long time poker fan, I've played hours and hours of this game on the Atari800Win PLus emulator.  It's just so addicting, especially when you find yourself on a lucky streak.
